author: Neuralink
description:
We’ve built a surgical robot to automate key steps in the process of receiving a Neuralink implant to promote safety, reliability, and scalability. 

Learn more about the role of the robot and its future potential from the engineers helping develop it.

Note: Neuralink devices are investigational and not FDA approved. This video features voluntary clinical trial participants sharing their personal experiences, which may not reflect all participants or future outcomes.
title: Automating Neurosurgery with Robotics | Neuralink
